name: Lucerne Spicy Chicken & Bell Pepper Queso Quesadillas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut crosswise into thin strips. Season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
2 tsp chili powder
¼ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice lengthwise into thin strips.

When the chicken is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Return chicken to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or panini press over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, add a tortilla; layer with a quarter of the cheese and a quarter of the chicken-pepper mixture. Close quesadilla with a second tortilla; grill, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. If you are using a panini press, close the lid and cook until cheese is melted. (Reserve remaining tortillas, cheese, and chicken-pepper mixture for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) pkg shredded cheese, queso quesadilla blend

instructions.primary_message: Flip quesadilla and continue to cook until the second side is lightly charred, 1 minute more. Remove from heat. Repeat with remaining tortillas, cheese, and chicken-pepper mixture to make 4 quesadillas.
Cut quesadillas in half and divide between plates. Serve with salsa, if desired, and enjoy!
